limitations: Only two Mac workers with correlated windows inside each fresh-context block; no robust confidence interval or guaranteed gain magnitude.

Counters have equal per-call wrapper overhead; fewer calls mean unequal total observation overhead. Synchronization counts are not GPU timing.
No demonstrated stutter improvement across both workers, physical phone result, UI merge result or general release approval.
